artifact_publication_precision.name: artifact_publication_precision
artifact_publication_precision.value: ("artifact"."published_at" is null and "artifact"."published_precision" = 'absent') or ("artifact"."published_at" is not null and "artifact"."published_precision" in ('day','month','year'))

observation_review_replacement.name: observation_review_replacement
observation_review_replacement.value: ("observation_review"."decision" = 'rejected' and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" is null) or ("observation_review"."decision" in ('confirmed','corrected') and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" is not null and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" <> "observation_review"."observation_id")

relationship_dates.name: relationship_dates
relationship_dates.value: "relationship"."valid_from" is null or "relationship"."valid_to" is null or "relationship"."valid_from" <= "relationship"."valid_to"
